note: The Shiva/Nilakantha poison metaphor (harmful contribution enters -> is contained -> destructive propagation=0 -> a persistent trace remains) proposed as a structural source for a Containment resolution mechanism distinct from Elimination Zero (KR-ZERO) and hypothesized Balance Zero. The immediate follow-up explicitly declines to ratify 'Containment Zero' as an algebraic Zero family member, renaming the three-way taxonomy 'Three Candidate Resolution Structures for Zero' pending experiment, and registers H-CONTAIN-01 (neutralization without erasure) and H-CONTAIN-02 (Contain(c,K_t) => Effect(c,K_{t+1})=0 and Trace(c,K_{t+1})!=empty) plus a Residual concept and extended H7/H8 hypotheses feeding KR-STATE-TRANSITION-01.

The hypothesis, motivated by discovering multiple non-equivalent Zeros (elimination/balance/containment/determination), that a knowledge state K_t cannot be a scalar and should instead be modeled as a structured multidimensional state observed through a family of projections Pi_i, with each Zero_i a distinct, non-mutually-entailing neutrality condition Zero_i(K_t|Q,T,Pi_i,Contract) rather than a single universal Zero. Corrects 'independent' to 'distinct/non-equivalent/non-mutually entailing', separates logical implication from statistical association/independence, requires stratified (not only pooled) analysis, and lays out the three-stage research ladder KR-STATE-01 (state structure) -> KR-STATE-02 (probabilistic representation) -> KR-STATE-03 (state-space cardinality), deliberately keeping probability and infinite-state claims downstream of empirical results.

aliases: Knowledge as a dynamic epistemic probability space
note: The hypothesis that knowledge is better modeled as a dynamic epistemic probability space -- a structured space Omega_E of possible epistemic states together with an evolving distribution P_t over those states, conditioned by questions/evidence/challenges/standards/history -- rather than a static set of facts or a single scalar. Distinguishes ontological space Omega_O, epistemic-possibility space Omega_E, and the knowledge distribution P_t; reframes 'many Zeros' as many epistemic projections of one underlying state space; and explicitly warns against the unproven chain 'multiple Zeros -> therefore probability -> therefore infinite-dimensional probability space', treating each step as a separate hypothesis to test in sequence.

notations: K_{t+1} becomes the substrate of future reasoning, not just its result
note: The hypothesis that K_{t+1} is not merely the output of reasoning on K_t but becomes the substrate/premise from which the next reasoning cycle proceeds (self-rebasing knowledge), making neutrality Z_t(x) temporally state-relative rather than an intrinsic property of x. Introduces a taxonomy of neutrality trajectories (stable, temporary, delayed activation, oscillation, stable relevance) explicitly demoted from 'fundamental' to 'candidate classes for experimental analysis'; an extended transition record TR_t=(K_t,I_t,K~_t,R_t,K_{t+1},Delta_t,Gamma_t); and a Future Epistemic Necessity predicate FEN_k(x|K_t) iff Obs(K_{t+k}^retain) != Obs(K_{t+k}^delete) under identical future inputs, used to test H_RET: current observational neutrality is not a safe proxy for future dispensability (the garbage-collection-unsafe hypothesis).

notations: 0_i = no operative influence attributed to d_i, not absence of d_i
note: Reframes 'Knowledge Zero' as the deliberate zeroing/neutralization of selected dimensions of a multidimensional knowledge state K=(d_1,...,d_n) to construct a Focus_S(K) (attention restricted to S) versus a Surface(K) (all dimensions jointly observed) observational frame, where d_i=0 denotes 'no operative influence attributed to dimension i under the current frame', explicitly not ontological absence, not an algebraic identity element, and not proof of future irrelevance. Documents cross-dimensional interaction (a dimension zero in isolation but non-zero jointly), the non-commutativity candidate R(P_S(K)) != P_S(R(K)) between focused reasoning and observational focus, and repeatedly strips premature scalar 'determination_score' fields from the proposed KR-STATE-01 Axis C data schema in favor of raw typed observation records.

Proposes that an epistemic point x is not an atomic node but a junction J(x) exposed by typed traversal relations (downward/inward, upward/outward, backward/retrospective, forward/prospective), explicitly rejecting 'four orthogonal axes' and 'directional vector' language in favor of a candidate typed traversal relation set R_trav={down,up,left,right} until orthogonality/independence is experimentally shown. Centers KR-STATE-01 Axis E on the existential empirical hypothesis H_E: exists K,Q,C,i,j such that Obs_Q(T_i(T_j(K))) != Obs_Q(T_j(T_i(K))) -- traversal-order non-commutativity -- while separately testing observational vs state-transition vs intermediate-state equivalence so a path difference is not mistaken for a mere representational difference, and removing a premature numeric 'determination_score' field from the data schema.

aliases: a value is a resolution boundary, not an atom
note: The hypothesis that an observed value x at one resolution can itself become a new epistemic base K_x with its own dimensions and relations at a finer resolution (recursive, resolution-dependent refinement -- explicitly demoted from 'fractal topology' to 'recursive, resolution-dependent epistemic framework' pending evidence), yielding Atomic(x|r) != Atomic(x|r+1) and Zero_r(d)!=>Zero_{r+1}(d) (Zero is local to a resolution). Distinguishes Zoom (expansion) from Compression (Zoom and Compression are explicitly NOT assumed to be inverses -- Q-reconstruction is a research question), and from ordinary decomposition. Specifies the KR-ZOOM-01 experimental protocol (four typed traversal directions INWARD/OUTWARD/RETROSPECTIVE/PROSPECTIVE, hypotheses H1-H6, mandatory audit gates 'Projection != Zero' and 'Exposed != Operatively Relevant', forbidden-overclaim list). Records the actual executed finding (via the Gita-cycle audit report) that zoom lost determination in ~7% of tested cases and gained it in none, plus an anchoring defect (AUDIT-2) that made the retain/delete counterfactual untestable by construction because zoom was anchored to a single dominant dimension. The follow-up KR-ZOOM-02 protocol then reframes Zoom as non-destructive attention-narrowing (Focus(K_t,O_i) preserves K_t intact; multi-hop investigation may traverse dimensions outside the initial focus mask), with a concrete Python execution harness.

aliases: K as dimensions plus relations (not a bare tuple)
note: Reframes the knowledge state from a bare dimension tuple K=(d_1,...,d_n) to K=(D,R), factors plus relations among them, on the principle that 'a distinguishable factor becomes epistemically informative only through a relation to something else under a question or purpose' (No distinction without relation); Focus is then re-defined as activating a selected relational subspace while neutralizing other influences. Separately uses a DDD Separation-of-Concerns model (Question/Claim/Evidence/Challenge/Determination/Revision bounded contexts, each owning a different responsibility) to locate where relational epistemic emptiness ('Sunya') arises: not in an object but in a missing or context-crossing relation (e.g. Claim minus Question, Claim minus Evidence), formalized as hypothesis H-SUNYA-01: Empty_{Q,C,E,S}(x,K_t) iff no justified Determine(d|x,Q,C,E,S,K_t) exists, explicitly not implying falsity or non-existence, and framed as DDD-derived architectural method combined with a Madhyamaka-derived philosophical hypothesis without claiming DDD proves Nagarjuna.

notations: Content Sunya / Determination Sunya / Field Sunya
aliases: Kashmir Shaivite consciousness-as-field lens on Knowledge Sunya
note: Proposes reading Knowledge Sunya against Kashmir Shaivite Consciousness-as-substratum philosophy (via a book on Kashmir Shaivism examined alongside Vijnanabhairava-style practice descriptions) rather than Buddhist Sunyata alone, on the strength of the book's own juxtaposition of Shaivite 'Everything is Shiva' and Buddhist 'Meditate on the Void' practices. Introduces a three-way distinction -- Content Sunya (R(x)=empty), Determination Sunya (no justified determination), and Field Sunya (forms/content quiet, but the field in which they arise is not thereby destroyed) -- via the analogy 'the empty screen is Consciousness, not non-existence', yielding the candidate principle 'Knowledge Sunya != no knowledge', and a comparative research program (Madhyamaka Sunyata <-> Kashmir Shaivism <-> KnowledgeOS) explicitly held as non-primitive philosophical inspiration.

notations: State -> Disturbance -> Identification -> Counter-action -> Removal/neutralization -> Restoration
aliases: Atharva Veda poison-removal / restoration structural inspiration
note: Uses the Atharva Veda's poison-removal-from-the-arrow and restoration imagery (via a Debroy-cited translation) as a non-authoritative structural inspiration for a Knowledge Purification cycle: a contaminating contribution P enters a state (K+P), and purification returns K rather than 0, distinguishing 'removal of information' (representation reduction, D->R) from 'removal of contamination' (knowledge purification, K->K') and 'Neutralize(K,x) != Delete(K,x)'. Proposes a DDD Epistemic Separation of Concerns (Claim/Evidence/Challenge/Qualification/Revision/Purification contexts, each with a candidate invariant such as Valid(K_{t+1})>=Valid(K_t)) and a reference-indexed contribution function C(x|R) explaining why a challenge can be negative relative to a claim while positive relative to the knowledge state; feeds a revised KR-CONTRIBUTION-01 hypothesis ladder (H1-H9: contribution, polarity, purification, balance, Zero separation, composition, commutativity, inverse, algebraic structure) and an explicit epistemic-provenance chain 'Atharva Veda -> Structural Inspiration -> Hypothesis -> Formalization -> Experiment -> Theory'.

Proposes a dialectic Contribution/Challenge/Balance layer for KR-ALGEBRA (Argument -> Challenge -> Contribution -> Opposition -> Balance -> possible Zero) as an addition to, not a replacement of, the existing Representation/Transformation/Observation-Zero lanes, with an explicit warning against preregistering C_Q^+(D)+C_Q^-(D)=0 because it already assumes the decomposition/operation/identity structure the experiment is supposed to discover -- the neutral starting point is C_Q(x|D) in an unknown structure C_Q with an unknown composition Gamma_Q. Introduces the claim-vs-knowledge reference-frame distinction for negative contributions (C(Ch|Claim)<0 while C(Ch|Knowledge)>0) and the BalanceZero != InformationZero / EliminationZero distinctions, and specifies the preregistered KR-CONTRIBUTION-01 hypothesis ladder H1-H9 (polarity discrimination through algebraic structure), plus corrections to the underlying reference document (minimal-sufficient-statistic overclaim, a mislabeled Data Processing Inequality, an unstated distributional assumption behind H(D)=n*log2(10), and 'Verification Axioms' relabeled 'Candidate Structural Properties').

A structured 15-document (Document 00 through 14) KnowledgeOS Theory v1.2 write-up dated 2026-09-04, organizationally distinct from the earlier 50-section consolidated draft (knowledgeos-information-transformation-theory-consolidated-draft-2026-09) though covering overlapping Zero/adequacy/realization/representation-reduction ground -- flagged POSSIBLY the same underlying theory-writing effort pending confirmation. This batch (B0065) contributes four of the fifteen: Document 03a (the concept of Zero -- distinguishes Zero from sufficiency/adequacy, from invariance, from graphoid-style conditional-irrelevance (fails both composition and decomposition), and from an independence system/matroid; states the exact Remainder identity A==C in 1182/1182 cases with B a different object; documents the elimination process L as terminating but non-confluent; and records higher-order eliminability up to k=3 for n<=6); Document 05 (Realization vs Adequacy formally separated, but the separation was never experimentally exhibited -- a named design defect in KR-REP-REDUCTION -- with one open conjecture Realization=>Adequacy); Document 06 (the R5->R4 rounding-to-3-significant-figures representation-adequacy boundary, explicitly scope-bound to one carrier/inquiry/chain/contract; Zero does NOT mark the boundary; a prior rank-convention/DECISION-01 claim is explicitly withdrawn after the audit found rank conventions are not invertible under ties); and Document 12 (a DDD strategic architecture model over the Zero/adequacy/realization kernel research -- five candidate bounded contexts, a constitutional read-disjointness invariant no single context can own, an Evidence & Contradiction context with unresolved ownership blocked on DECISION-02, aggregate/event/port design forced by the data, and eight named anti-patterns).

note: A recurring, numbered-cycle self-audit practice that re-tests, on each cycle's freshest corpus batch, whether the Bhagavad Gita reading strand should ever be promoted from an external interpretive lens to kernel-primitive status, explicitly run as a falsification attempt against the standing prior-cycle recommendation rather than as confirmation.
